subject: HANDOFF: app-process restart requires foreign-lease cleanup-before-arm after Phase1 CAS
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-process-recovery-20261001. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=FINAL_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e; MAIN_CHANGED_DURING_RND=NO. Live bus remains legacy /messages + /artifacts. SOURCE-CONFIRMED: ShizukuBridge uses daemon(true), so DuoShellService/cover lease may survive app-process death. Fresh FoldOverlayService has a new serviceEpoch/Gen2 kernel, but on Shizuku Ready calls onPrivilegedReady()->reconcileCoverLease before arm; first reconcile uses shellSession=0 wildcard and can accept a surviving non-IDLE shell snapshot. Current main loses prior app service identity entirely. RECONCILIATION: primary staged DUO_OPEN_GEN3_PHASE1_AUTHORITY_V2.zip already adds ownerServiceEpoch/ownerCloseCycleId and V4 exact CAS; that correctly prevents a prior-process token from counting as the new close-cycle owner without exact CAS. Do not duplicate it. REMAINING GAP: Phase1 does not change startup reconcile/arm; a prior-service HELD lease can remain resident while the fresh process sets renderOwnershipArmed=true, has no local active close cycle, and hideMirror does not release the cover lease. RECOMMENDATION: after Phase1 lands, add one service-start Fold7ProcessRecoveryGate before visual/content/presentation owners arm. First non-IDLE token with ownerServiceEpoch != current serviceEpoch is FOREIGN_PRIOR_SERVICE; exact-release/reconcile it and remain disarmed until shell state is clean. If startup posture is mid-transition after provenance loss, WAIT_FRESH_EDGE rather than joining the dead process's attempt. Compose with reviewer daemon UNKNOWN_RECOVERY and state-rd AngleAuthority; no raw physical OFF. MODEL: 13/13 deterministic PASS; fixed-seed 100,000-event run produced 66,734 Phase1 foreign-HELD-resident modeled cases and 0 proposed-gate invariant failures (not a real-world probability estimate). Device validation remains required to confirm same shell PID/session and persistent lease across an app-only process kill on Fold7. No production writes.
